NSU
Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution offering programs in information technology.<SEP>NSU (Novosibirsk State University) is the institution where the FIT faculty is located and where teaching staff are employed.<SEP>NSU is the Novosibirsk State University, an educational institution that provides infrastructure for students.<SEP>Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution offering various academic programs.

FIT
The Faculty of Information Technologies is a department within NSU that provides education in computer science and engineering.<SEP>FIT is a faculty that prepares bachelors in informatics and computer engineering, combining fundamental training with practical experience.<SEP>The faculty offering a bachelor's degree program and various student support services.

SBRAS
SBRAS is an institution that maintains professional connections with the FIT faculty.

SberLab-NSU
SberLab-NSU is an educational and scientific laboratory established as a partnership between the university and industry.

SHIFT NSU-CFT
SHIFT NSU-CFT is an educational and scientific laboratory focused on industry-academic collaboration.

PGLab NSU-Postgres Professional
PGLab NSU-Postgres Professional is an educational and scientific laboratory dedicated to database technology research.

Computer Science and Systems Engineering
Computer Science and Systems Engineering is a specialized academic profile offered by the faculty.

Curriculum Topics
Curriculum Topics include software engineering, artificial intelligence, deep machine learning, computer vision, big data analytics, high-performance cluster systems, bioinformatics, and blockchain technologies.

SO RAN
SO RAN (Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences) is a network of research institutes that maintains professional connections with the faculty.<SEP>A network of institutes that serves as a base for student internships.

SberLab-NSU Laboratory
A research laboratory established as a partnership between Sber and NSU.

A research laboratory established as a partnership between NSU and CFT.

Novosibirsk State University
Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution that hosts the Faculty of Information Technologies.<SEP>Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution that combines natural science, engineering, and humanities competencies, offering various bachelor's programs.<SEP>Novosibirsk State University (NSU) is an educational institution that offers various bachelor's degree programs, faculties, and student services.<SEP>Novosibirsk State University is a higher education institution that houses the Mechanics and Mathematics Department.

Faculty Of Information Technologies
The Faculty of Information Technologies is a department within Novosibirsk State University offering undergraduate programs in informatics and computer science.

Informatics And Computer Engineering
Informatics and Computer Engineering is an academic field of study offered as a bachelor's degree program at the Faculty of Information Technologies.

Software Engineering and Computer Science is a specialized academic profile offered within the Informatics and Computer Engineering program.

Computer Science and System Engineering is a specialized academic profile offered within the Informatics and Computer Engineering program.
